assumptions.featureTiming: All market features use the last fully closed BTCUSD Index daily observation before cluster start; Funding uses only events with fundingTime before cluster start.
assumptions.crashClusterSource: Stage 3 frozen crash clusters, reproduced from the same 1H execution/index data.
assumptions.outcomeSource: Stage 3 frozen dynamic leave-one-crash-out marginal ending BTC.
assumptions.hypothesisFormation: Candidate predicates and thresholds are fixed before the run. 2024 chooses condition/other by mean incremental BTC only; 2025 and 2026 are frozen validation.

continuousThresholds.baselineExposure: 1.0, an existing V3 base target boundary
